usage: Outside collaborators should not be repo admins
name: exposed organization repos
description: Outside collaborators are not members of your organization or first-level group and as such may pose a great security risk if their account gets compromised. They should be admins of a repo in very exceptional cases.
detailedDescription: Outside collaborators are not members of your organization or first-level group. A best practice is to limit the access time and permissions they have to a repository. You may not be aware of a change in the status of an outside admin and also not immediately become aware if their account gets compromised. This is why it is safer to prevent them from having admin access.
